journey.name: grant signup
journey.description: Verifies grant signup using the existing authorization and profile setup screens. Precondition: an isolated unlocked wallet with Paykit enabled and no Pubky identity. A controlled requesting app supplies a fresh signup_grant URL, a reachable homeserver and relay, and a valid signup token when the homeserver requires one. The URL requests ordinary app permissions without a Bitkit companion claim. Record its client ID, homeserver, and requested permissions.

actions.action: Open the prepared signup_grant URL in Bitkit
Verify the authorization sheet shows the recorded requesting app and permissions
Verify the requested homeserver is shown (id "PubkySignupHomeserver")
Tap Cancel on the authorization sheet
Verify the wallet still has no Pubky identity and the requesting app remains unapproved
Open a fresh signup_grant URL from the same requesting app in Bitkit
Tap Authorize (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") and complete PIN or biometric approval when enabled
Verify the existing Create Profile screen is shown (id "CreateProfileSave")
Verify the requesting app receives approval for the same public key that Bitkit registered on the requested homeserver
Enter a display name and save the profile (id "CreateProfileSave")
Verify the profile is available in Bitkit
